text:
maria: Quick design idea — for bulk-approve in Prompt Sets, show a short toast with an Undo CTA instead of forcing users into a modal. current mock places the toast top-right and we also currently shift focus to the row, which is causing a11y flags. kevin: link to figma? maria: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Bulk-approve-toast (mock). Main concerns: 1) screen reader announcement content, 2) keyboard/focus flow (we shouldn't trap on a toast). asha: a11y note — toasts should be announced via aria-live and not steal focus. If we move focus to the row it can break screen reader context. Recommend aria-live="polite" + role="status", and move focus only on explicit keyboard action. kevin: makes sense. current implementation was reusing our mini-modal focus trap code, which was wrong. I'll remove the trap. maria: wording question — prefer "Approved 12 prompt sets" vs "12 prompt sets approved"? also how long should toast persist? jessica: prefer "Approved 12 prompt sets — Undo" (short, actionable). 6s timeout feels reasonable but keep Undo visible until focus leaves it. asha: for SR we should include an offscreen sentence: "12 prompt sets approved. Press undo to revert." and use aria-atomic so the entire message is read. sample snippet: ```html
Approved 12 prompt sets.
``` kevin: good, i'll implement aria-live & aria-atomic. question: where should focus return if user hits Esc or Undo? tom: acceptance criteria: (1) toast announced to screen readers, (2) no focus trap, (3) keyboard accessible Undo, (4) focus returns to the triggering checkbox or list selection on Esc/undo. maria: agree. also microcopy tweak: use sentence case on toast CTA -> "Undo" (not "UNDO"). kevin: will add tests (unit + e2e with NVDA/VoiceOver smoke). I'll also add a tiny animation so toast doesn't steal attention visually. asha: quick keyboard flow to validate: Tab -> toast Undo, Enter -> undo action (announce revert), Esc -> close toast and return focus to triggering row. Please add screen reader acceptance test steps. deploy-bot: UAT environment updated with branch bulk-approve-toast for testing. jessica: :thumbsup: nice. maria: assigning to @kevin for implementation and @asha to write SR test steps. I'll follow up after UAT pass. Thanks everyone!
